Setting.Name: AgentFAQSideBar::Articles###001
Setting.Description: Configure the articles for the agent interface sidebar, according to the language. Relevant fields: Language: Defines the language in which the sidebar will be displayed; DefaultItemID: ID of the FAQ article that will be displayed by default in the Zoom view; CustomGroupOrder: Custom order for displaying the article grouping categories; Articles: Definition of the grouping categories and the articles to display, up to 2 levels deep. For example: Service Desk::10 will display the link to the FAQ article with ID=10 for the "Service Desk" group, or Service Desk::Security::20 will display the "Service Desk > Security" group and within it the link to the FAQ article with ID=20.
